svg.title: Fotolo auth
svg.text: The app holds two tokens: a short-lived access token for every request, and a refresh token that only buys new tokens.

The app reads the expiry from the token before
each request and refreshes if it's almost out, so
requests don't fail halfway. If several requests
need a refresh at once, they share one refresh
